```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
all_utts <- read_csv(here("../data/all_corpora_adj_noun_conc_utts.csv"))

sample_to_code <- all_utts %>%
  distinct(dataset, doc_id, sentence) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  sample_n(250) %>%
  ungroup()

#write_csv(sample_to_code, here("../data/all_corpora_utts_to_code.csv"))
```

```{r}
all_coded <- read_csv(here("../data/all_corpora_utts_to_code.csv")) %>%
  left_join(all_utts %>% select(dataset, doc_id, sentence, adj_token, noun_token), 
            by = c("dataset", "doc_id", "sentence")) %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(adj_token, noun_token, sep = " ")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = str_squish(pair)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(sentence, doc_id) %>%
  summarise(parser_pairs = list(pair)) %>%
  ungroup() 

bm <- read.csv(here("../data/all_corpora_utts_coded_BM.csv")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(adj, noun, sep = " ")) %>%
  mutate(pair = str_squish(pair)) %>%
  group_by(sentence, doc_id) %>%
  summarise(bm_pairs = list(pair)) %>%
  ungroup()
 
cb <- read.csv(here("../data/all_corpora_utts_coded_CB.csv")) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(adj, noun, sep = " ")) %>%
  mutate(pair = str_squish(pair)) %>%
  group_by(sentence, doc_id) %>%
  summarise(cb_pairs = list(pair)) %>%
  ungroup() 

all_coded <- all_coded %>%
  left_join(bm, by = c("sentence", "doc_id")) %>%
  left_join(cb, by = c("sentence", "doc_id"))
```

```{r}
get_intersect <- function(list1, list2) {
  
  if (typeof(list1) == "list" & typeof(list2) == "list") {
    print("list list")
    print(list1)
    print(list2)
    return(intersect(list1, list2))
  } else if (typeof(list1) == "character" & typeof(list2) == "character") {
    print("character character")
    print(list1)
    print(list2)
    return(c(intersect(list1, list2)))
  } else if (typeof(list1) == "character" & typeof(list2) == "list") {
    print(intersect(c(list1), list2))
    return(intersect(c(list1), list2))
  } else if (typeof(list1) == "list" & typeof(list2) == "character") {
    print(intersect(list1, c(list2)))
    return(intersect(list1, c(list2)))
  }
}
jaccard <- all_coded %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(human_intersect = list(intersect(bm_pairs, cb_pairs)),
         cb_parser_intersect = list(intersect(cb_pairs, parser_pairs)),
         bm_parser_intersect = list(intersect(bm_pairs, parser_pairs)),
         human_union = list(union(bm_pairs, cb_pairs)),
         cb_parser_union = list(union(cb_pairs, parser_pairs)),
         bm_parser_union = list(union(bm_pairs, parser_pairs))) %>%
  mutate(human_jaccard = length(human_intersect)/length(human_union),
         cb_parser_jaccard = length(cb_parser_intersect)/length(cb_parser_union),
         bm_parser_jaccard = length(bm_parser_intersect)/length(bm_parser_union))

human_jaccard_avg <- mean(jaccard$human_jaccard)
cb_parser_jaccard_avg <- mean(jaccard$cb_parser_jaccard)
bm_parser_jaccard_avg <- mean(jaccard$bm_parser_jaccard)
```
